meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: Claude 会从你的 claude-mem 观察记录里筛出一批,编译成可对话的知识库,你就能就这批内容提问,追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里建立专注的「大脑」、询问过去的工作模式,或就某个主题汇编经验时触发。

say.text: 加载 hooks-expertise,然后问它 5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发
say.note: 加载后提问,后续追问保留上下文

say.text: 列出所有语料库和它们的加载状态
say.note: 显示每个语料库的统计和是否已加载

howto.what_en: Claude filters your claude-mem observations into a corpus, compiles it into a conversational knowledge base, and answers your questions about it; follow-ups keep context.
howto.when_en: Use when you want a focused "brain" from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a corpus called hooks-expertise from claude-mem hooks observations.
say_en.note: Filters observations by project, type, concept, and more.

say_en.text: Prime hooks-expertise, then ask when each of the 5 lifecycle hooks fires.
say_en.note: After priming, follow-up questions keep context.

say_en.text: List all corpora and their stats.
say_en.note: Shows each corpus's stats and priming status.
